verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports sign-in with a Google account instead of API keys (gh-13), but multiple developers report that their existing paid Gemini subscription doesn't actually grant extra usage in the CLI — you need a separate 'Code Assist Standard/Enterprise' plan — and explicitly wish for a unified subscription like Claude's Max plan (gemini-cli-comm-2, gemini-cli-comm-3, gemini-cli-comm-19).
